The second path connects vinblastine to PC10, which is targeted by Loperamide oxide, also leading to FaDu. Both pathways highlight a dependency on specific compounds that modulate cellular responses, potentially through receptor activation or signaling pathways. The integration of these evidence points suggests that vinblastine may exert its effects on FaDu via a series of molecular intermediates, possibly involving receptor-mediated signaling or metabolic pathways.
